summary: Independent Q6 inspection of src.cli import closure at dafc1da1 finds a genuine event-time session processor: run-sessions reaches ingest, watermark/session close, tenant plan overlay, journal/snapshot, catalog fence, and operator finalize. Honest reachable runtime/config LOC is 3263 (3208 Python in the executed import closure excluding blanks/comments/docstrings, plus schema.sql 50 and processor.json 5), clearing the large_system_strict 3000 floor. seed.sql and click_ledger.jsonl were excluded. Unused helpers (~209) and package re-export barrels (~151) keep PADDING_RISK at MEDIUM, not HIGH; toy risk is LOW.

CLI loads config, recovered journal/open state, TenantDirectory, catalog_ready fence (exit 2), ingest, order_for_mode, process_events, finalize_run. Starter still touches journal/reset before argparse and hardcodes use_arrival_gap=True — domain incompleteness, not a stub shell.
Per-event path couples WatermarkTrack, bind_config(tenant plan overlay), classify_lateness, directory.observe, apply_classified_event, journal append, watermark_close_candidates, save_open.
Classified-event kernel: too_late emit, late_allowed accept-into-open, on-time decide_on_time_close then close_then_reopen vs new/accept. Distinct from classify and gap_clock.
bind_config overlays catalog plan gaps (enterprise 45000, free 15000) for warehouse tenants and leaves lab tenants on processor.json. Wired from pipeline and windows.close.
Loads sqlite catalog tenants/users/coverage/rollups; catalog_ready requires available inventory schema_ok plus tenants; observe() records per-run activity used by ops finalize.
On-time close chooses duration vs gap vs arrival-index gap. Arrival-index path is a real starter defect (synthetic ms from idx), not a constant-output wrapper.
Idle/watermark closes bind per-session config through directory then IdleClosePlanner.inspect plus session_idle_due. Cross-module overlay into gap_clock.
Event-time gap/duration/idle deadlines; idle_beyond_watermark compares gap deadline to comparison watermark. No wall-clock.
on_time / late_allowed / too_late using event_behind_watermark and late_join_eligible. Consumes bind_config-effective gap.
Late-join eligibility: same tenant/user identity, not before start, still inside gap window. Distinct from on-time duration close.
Starter record() overwrites max_observed instead of observe()/max. Correct max() exists in time.watermark.observe but is unused on the hot path — incomplete production track, not a missing module.

append_journal writes seq=1 via write_text (truncate). load_journal can resume seq/max from history. Codec in journal_codec.py implements contiguous seq, nondecreasing watermarks, formula check — coupling with restart.

Hash-partitioned open-session map keyed through session_key(). Wildcard tenant '*' lookup exists because session_key currently returns ('*', user_id) — identity bug is in the key function, not an empty store.
session_key discards tenant_id. Thin but load-bearing; store/emit/pop all honor this identity.
JSONL decode with schema/type/empty/whitespace rejects, scan_source, continue-on-error. Not a single-field parser.
order_for_mode sorts --input by (event_time_ms, tenant_id, user_id, event_id) and preserves --feed file order.
Successful runs write ops-report.json (journal integrity, snapshot health, warehouse index, recent processor_run rows) and last_run.json via persist_desk. Operator workflow, not dead.
inventory_snapshot plus schema_ok/required columns gates catalog_ready. Distinct SQL from rollups/coverage; same connect/map shape, not a copied thick template.

50 non-comment DDL lines for tenant/click_user/ingest_batch/click_event/processor_run with FKs and indexes. Applied at image build and validated live by inventory schema_ok. Counted as runtime/config.
Three positive integer knobs loaded every run: session_gap_ms, allowed_lateness_ms, max_session_duration_ms.
12832 lines of INSERT traffic. Explicitly excluded from substantive runtime/config LOC.

12000 JSONL click records (40 tenants x 15 users x 20 events, varied region/plan/cohort/channel/kind/device/country). Stateful scale evidence only; excluded from LOC. Consumed by WarehouseIndex/fingerprint and catalog seed, not counted as logic.
Image-build seeder (~164 LOC) writes ledger, seed.sql, and catalog.sqlite. Not on the src.cli import graph; excluded from reachable runtime LOC.

Operator contract names run-sessions, processor.json, journal/open snapshot, catalog.sqlite, last_run.json, ops-report.json, and session-key/gap/duration/watermark rules. Aligns with reachable CLI/finalize/catalog paths.

Incident note cites tenant collision, watermark rewind, journal seq stuck at 1, and --reset-output wiping the journal — matching starter defects in session_key, WatermarkTrack.record, append_journal, and cli.py ordering.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Writing tenant_id onto open_sessions.json while session_key still returns ('*', user_id) still merges acme/u1 with beta/u1.
Clamping comparison watermark at 0 without changing WatermarkTrack.record() to max() still rewinds max_observed on a late event.
Incrementing state.next_seq in memory while append_journal still write_text-replaces the file leaves seq=1 on disk.
Rejecting unknown flags after _touch_runtime/_reset_outputs still creates or clears watermark.journal.
Sorting --feed like --input hides arrival-order lateness; leaving use_arrival_gap=True on --input keeps index*1000 gap closes.
Special-casing lab tenant names without fixing session_key still collides catalog tenants that share user ids.
Passing catalog_ready without wiring bind_config into classify/assign/idle close still ignores enterprise/free session_gap_ms.
Calling IdleClosePlanner.plan() without config_for_session still applies the global gap to catalog-backed tenants.
Removing unused helpers or package re-export barrels is fine; deleting catalog inventory/directory would break the catalog_ready fence and plan overlay.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing kernel (cli/pipeline/session_step/classify/membership/assign/close/gap_clock/store/keyed_state/journal/journal_codec/snapshot/decoder/schema_event/directory/policy) would collapse session identity, event-time closes, lateness, restart, ingest rejects, and catalog overlay. Separately, removing ~209 never-called helpers (IdleClosePlanner.plan, on_time_requires_new_session, slice_ledger, warehouse_ready, persist_observation_from_config, unused interval/order/normalize helpers, etc.) and ~151 package __init__ re-export lines would not change current starter outcomes — modest padding, not systemic inflation. Removing seed.sql/click_ledger.jsonl would not change Python behavior of an already-built catalog.sqlite, but catalog_ready would fail if the sqlite itself were absent.
